name: Gabaculine
summary: Gabaculine is a naturally occurring neurotoxin first isolated from the bacteria Streptomyces toyacaensis, which acts as a potent and irreversible GABA transaminase inhibitor, and also a GABA reuptake inhibitor. Gabaculine is also known as 3-amino-2,3-dihydrobenzoic acid hydrochloride and 5-amino cyclohexa-1,3 dienyl carboxylic acid.

pharmacology.text: Gabaculine is a naturally occurring neurotoxin first isolated from the bacteria Streptomyces toyacaensis, which acts as a potent and irreversible GABA transaminase inhibitor, and also a GABA reuptake inhibitor.
pharmacology.kind: GABA-T inhibitor; GABA reuptake inhibitor; GABA transporter 1 (GAT-1) inhibitor; Anticonvulsant

uses.en: It is used only as a research tool to study how the brain breaks down GABA. It is too toxic for medical use.
uses.zh: 它只作為研究工具，用來探討大腦如何分解 GABA，毒性過高，無法用於醫療。
uses.zhHans: 它只作为研究工具，用来探讨大脑如何分解 GABA，毒性过高，无法用于医疗。

sideEffects.en: It is a neurotoxin and is not used in people. In animals, drugs that block GABA breakdown this strongly can cause severe sedation and toxic effects.
sideEffects.zh: 它是一種神經毒素，不用於人體。在動物實驗中，如此強力阻斷 GABA 分解的藥物可能造成嚴重鎮靜與毒性反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它是一种神经毒素，不用于人体。在动物实验中，如此强力阻断 GABA 分解的药物可能造成严重镇静与毒性反应。

fact.en: Gabaculine is a so-called suicide inhibitor: the enzyme it targets starts to process it, and in doing so turns it into a stable aromatic ring that stays locked onto the enzyme for good.
fact.zh: 加巴庫林是所謂的「自殺型抑制劑」：目標酵素開始處理它時，會把它轉變成穩定的芳香環，從此牢牢卡在酵素上無法脫離。
fact.zhHans: 加巴库林是所谓的「自杀型抑制剂」：目标酵素开始处理它时，会把它转变成稳定的芳香环，从此牢牢卡在酵素上无法脱离。
